title: Static + Animated Logotype
summary: Threads is a contemporary clothing retail brand targeting young, fashion conscious shoppers and local trendsetters.

overview.challenge: The brief was to reinterpret the Threads logotype for a clothing retailer, making the name feel connected to the physical act of exchanging and wearing garments.
overview.solution: Rather than treating the name as purely metaphorical, the concept centers on the physical behavior of thread itself, how it loops, pulls, overlaps, and binds garments together.
overview.outcome: The final identity pairs a continuous-stroke logotype with a motion piece in which a line travels between bags, suggesting an ongoing cycle of clothing exchange.

blocks.label: 01 — Sketches
blocks.heading: Drawing with one continuous thread
blocks.body: I explored how a single continuous stroke could form the letters while staying legible. Secondary strokes test the idea of threads crossing and weaving, adding movement without obscuring the core wordmark.

blocks.label: 02 — Final
blocks.caption: The final Threads logotype applied to retail signage.
